intentionalConventions: Portraits during explicitly labeled messenger conversations are intentional conversation portraits, not evidence of physical presence
Narrator closeups, looking away, unseen classmates and voice-only lines may intentionally omit sprites
Affectionate smiles used as concealment in thriller scenes are not automatically replaced by fearful expressions
Conservative graph background unions include infeasible conditional edges; they require scene-context review
The bedroom/gate crossover uses an explicit brief CG memory flash before the corridor apparition; the flash is not a permanent background
The mirror effect separates actual Seolhwa from her absent reflection; retain that deliberate contrast
Static VN portraits identify a person and expression without illustrating every described hand movement or prop
Postcredits and observer logs deliberately use black backgrounds
